plugins.name: requirements-engineering
plugins.description: The requirements-engineering role on contract v3 (issue-160 round-4 promotion). Decides: 요구사항이 검증가능·일관·추적 가능하게 명세되었는가.

plugins.name: req-id-gate
plugins.description: Facet gate for requirements-engineering (issue #10): every requirement in the phase-2 record must carry a unique REQ-<id> and a nearby verification condition. Ships agents/requirements-scout.md to front-load elicitation before drafting.

plugins.name: traceability-matrix-gate
plugins.description: Facet gate for requirements-engineering (issue #10): the phase-2 record's traceability matrix must have the ID/Description/Source/Downstream Link columns and a row for every REQ-<id> in the record.

plugins.name: ambiguity-resolution-gate
plugins.description: Facet gate for requirements-engineering (issue #10): the phase-2 record must carry an ambiguity section that is either explicitly empty or has every entry resolved or escalated.

plugins.name: proposal-discipline-gate
plugins.description: Phase-1 process gate for requirements-engineering (issue #10): every proposal under docs/issue-*/proposals/*requirements-engineering*.md must carry the 7 required sections per docs/issue-1/proposals/requirements-engineering.md (a).
